name: process-design-vibecoding
description: Turn project requests into a maintained specification, acceptance criteria and verified delivery.

interface.longDescription: A reusable software project workflow for Codex and ChatGPT. Capture material requests, update the canonical specification before implementation, track proposals and deferred changes, and reconcile requirements with verification evidence. Use host-provided Context7 to check version-compatible library, framework and API documentation; disclose unavailable documentation. Offer optional scenario diagrams when they clarify actions, integration calls and outcomes, using the current model. Scales down for bounded fixes and preserves existing conventions.
defaultPrompt: Use Process Design Vibecoding to turn my project idea into a specification and acceptance criteria.
Примени Process Design Vibecoding: внеси мои новые требования в основное ТЗ и обнови приёмку и план.
